newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Banco Excel Economico launches credit card.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Banco Excel Economico launches credit card.

text.p: Brazilian private bank Banco Excel Economico said it would launch a credit card with Mastercard brand.
The ExcelCard MasterCard will be the first credit card offered by the bank which was formed after Excel earlier this year took over failed bank Banco Economico, a bank spokesman said.
The launch of ExcelCard involves partnerships with four entertainment companies: Art Filmes, Playarte, Paris Filmes and Fox Warner do Brasil, he added.
Further details were to be given at a news conference today at 2:30 p.m./1730 GMT here.
